title: Hold a licence to sell X 18+ films
what: Sell or copy films classified X 18+ only under a licence.

laws.title: Classification (Publications, Films and Computer Games) (Enforcement) Act 1995 (ACT)

sources.title: Classification (Publications, Films and Computer Games) (Enforcement) Act 1995 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 22(4) (current republication (R24, from 16 November 2025; Classification (Publications, Films and Computer Games) (Enforcement) Act 1995 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person sells or copies a film classified X 18+; and (b) the sale or copying is not done in accordance with a licence under part 6
